svg.title: SONIC general-purpose computer-use architecture
svg.desc: Operator outcome flows through Boss orchestration, a general computer-use worker, grounded GUI or appropriate execution capabilities, fresh observations, and independent Judge review. Safety and evidence controls span the flow.
svg.text: SONIC | General-purpose AI computer user
Architecture overview · components and intended flow, not a universal capability claim
Operator outcome
Desired result · constraints · observable completion evidence
Boss orchestration
Analyze · plan · delegate bounded work · review evidence · replan
No dedicated browser-specialist worker
Ordinary ComputerUseAgent worker
Fresh state → reason about assigned objective → ground action → dispatch → observe
Ambiguous, stale, or off-screen targets are blocked rather than guessed
Visible workstation GUI
Discover and use installed desktop applications
NSI state + accessibility + screenshot when needed
Current visible evidence grounds each GUI action
Other appropriate capabilities
Files · terminal · Git · APIs, when suited to the task
Must not replace an explicitly requested GUI workflow
Provider and policy wiring are environment-specific
Fresh evidence → independent Judge review
Confirm, report partial progress, or mark blocked / unverified
Policy and receipts cover supported paths; verify deployment wiring. Tests do not prove real multi-app task completion.
